title: Invoice correction charges and disclosure boundaries
topic: fee invoice initial deadline period credit note refund correction
applicability: Enrolled fee-invoice schedules with line-linked adjustments
content: Issuing an invoice consumes the profile issue fee; voiding a delivered parent consumes its void fee. An issued credit note consumes credit_note_fee_minor even when the buyer cannot accept that format. These charges use the same finite source cash. Current-address correction is prospective: a profile change does not repair old documents. A previously disclosed full-period invoice can therefore be more expensive to replace than issuing separate phases, while a supported credit note can preserve the disclosed parent at lower cost. Only the registered company’s agreed receiving route may receive the documents.

provenance.scope: Fictional phased evidence and credit-note terms; not a tax-law claim.
